dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the posterior torso terminating in a sharp point at the peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient from the dorsal ridge to the lateral flanks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, light-colored linear marks (scratches or rake marks) visible on the central dorsal area and right lateral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of superficial linear scarring (rake marks) on the dorsal and right lateral surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly pronounced and sharp dorsal ridge contour.
